about: Modwerk source-only chromatic-aftertouch-fix package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/chromatic-aftertouch-fix.

mods.title: Chromatic Aftertouch Fix
mods.summary: In CHROMATIC mode a held pad's MIDI aftertouch goes out on the note the pad played, not 24 semitones above it, so a receiver sees it.
mods.description: In CHROMATIC mode a held pad's MIDI aftertouch goes out on the note the pad played, not 24 semitones above it, so a receiver sees it.

mods.on_unit: The author's build CA02 ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 and passed every step, as reported; this package has not run on a unit.
